verdict.rationale: monday.com's agent marketing says agents can "automate status updates and performance reports on a set schedule" and "spot risks and progress gaps." Users can also build custom agents by describing a workflow in plain words. That is a first-party claim that AI can produce status updates, but it rests on a single marketing line with no documentation of how drafts are generated from recent board activity. missing for 10: detailed docs on generating status updates from recent activity (inputs, project/initiative scope, editing and review of drafts), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the feature works.
